text: I am Dr. Agent. I see you have a 2-day history of fever and altered mental status. To begin our assessment, can you tell me your age and if you have any underlying medical conditions?

speaker: Patient
text: 22-year-old male. The patient presents with a 2-day history of fever and altered mentation, reporting fever without chills and rigors. He denies sore throat, abdominal pain, headache, loose stool, burning micturition, or seizures. Has a history of tics and is currently taking haloperidol.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Neuroleptic Malignant Syndrome (NMS).

I have noted your age and the use of haloperidol for tics. Given the fever, altered mental status, and lack of other infectious or traumatic symptoms, I will now request specific labs to confirm muscle rigidity and metabolic derangement. REQUEST TEST: CBC, CMP, CPK, and TSH.
